title: Hand Gesture Sensor System
description: An analog electronics project that detects and interprets human hand gestures using sensor-based circuitry. The system converts physical hand movements into electronic signals that can control devices.

title: Data Science Analysis Project
description: A Python-based data science project involving data analysis, visualization, and visualization using libraries such as Pandas and Matplotlib to explore patterns in scientific datasets.

title: Hydrogen Energy and Solar Cell Study
description: A small research-oriented project exploring hydrogen as a clean energy carrier and studying the working principles of solar cells as renewable energy technologies.

title: Computational Modelling of Radioactive Decay
description: A computational physics project that models the exponential decay behavior of radioactive materials using numerical simulation techniques in Python.
